title: Work queue tickets: types and stages (Piece 2, P2-1)
why: Jason's Piece 2 (decisions/0179; handoffs/piece2-team.md, approved 2026-11-25, Q2 A and Q3 A): the Work queue's tasks become Work, Audit or Resolution tickets; Work moves through Planning, Building, Implementation and Confirmation by its gates; a Tier 3 is a Decision Brief the Founder answers on the page. The same queue, extended in place. Only the Founder answers a Tier 3: the answer checks Access::isFounder() (an active staff login at the founder level), never who(), which calls a request with no staff session the Founder.
data_reason: Gives each open task already in the Work queue its first stage, once (only rows with no stage): a release named → Implementation; taken and scoped → Building; the rest → Planning. Done and withdrawn tasks keep no stage. Changes nothing else. Adds one Work ticket, once (only when it isn't there): "Audit cron callers of Access::can() (it returns true with no staff session)", Tier 2, at Planning, its source handoffs/piece2-team.md §1 finding 2 (the session manager, 2026-11-25).

changes.what: Each task's type and stage on its row; a Tier 3 waiting for the Founder first; the filter by type and stage; the Team icon
A task's page: the stage strip, what it needs to move on, Move, ✎ back a stage; No decision applies
A Resolution ticket's Decision Brief, Send to the Founder, Choose A / B / Answer in my words, the precedent ticket
Confirmation: a task is Done once its release is live and every step is confirmed (Jason's Q2 A)
FAQ: the Work queue's answer, its types and stages

founder_check: Proved on the bench (tools/team-tests/tickets.php, 2026-11-25): with no staff session Access::who() is ['founder',''] but Access::isFounder() is false; api.php's qanswer asks isFounder() first and refuses with 403; the answer buttons are greyed with the reason for anyone but the Founder's own active staff login; a staff login at executive level is refused too.
rollback: Proved on the bench (tools/team-tests/rollback.sh, 2026-11-25): the zip laid over the live mirror (Sync 17:36 UTC, with #287) and its migrations run twice, then Roll back as the site does it (each file put back from live, the new ones removed): the files match live byte for byte, every PHP file parses, and the Work queue's own suite (work-queue.cjs, as on main) passes 84 of 84 on the rolled-back code. Left behind: the tables control_gauge_task_moves and control_gauge_task_briefs and the new columns on control_gauge_tasks, unused (migrations only add).
